item.title: Introduction to Electric Power Systems
item.description:
The textbook presents an example-driven approach to power systems, moving from foundational concepts to system-level analysis. It emphasizes equivalent models, and computational techniques for engineering design.

 

Key Topics

  • Network theory
  • AC power flow
  • Polyphase systems
  • Symmetrical components
  • Electric machines

Author: James L. Kirtley Jr.
